subject: Stakeholder playbook + champion kit for Acme Health evaluation
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder playbook + champion kit for Acme Health evaluation

Hi Laura — thanks again for today's call. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary use case: clinical notes summarization for internal analytics and provider workflow.
- Key success metrics: 95% reduction in manual triage time, sub-2s latency on common requests, and cost target <$0.003/token for production mix.
- Timeline: pilot (8 weeks) -> evaluate with 3 pilot workflows -> procurement for org-wide rollout (Q4 target).

Stakeholder map (what we suggest so you can champion internally)
- Champion: Laura Bennett (you) — day-to-day product sponsor and ROI storyteller.
- Economic buyer: Oliver Grant (VP of Ops) — cares about unit economics and headcount savings.
- Security/compliance: Nadia Shah (Security Lead) — will need SOC2 evidence and data flow diagrams.
- Procurement: procure@acmehealth.com — standard PO/term negotiation.

What we are sending (attached)
- Stakeholder playbook PDF: one-page mapping + suggested internal email templates your champions can forward.
- Single-slide ROI: concise numbers and assumptions for an exec one-pager.
- Champion email template: copy/paste to introduce Redwood to finance/procurement.

Immediate ask / next steps
1) Can you confirm Oliver + Nadia are the right contacts and share any scheduling constraints?
2) Would you like me to intro via email or send the one-pager first for you to forward?
3) Proposed joint meeting with Nadia + procurement for next Wed/Thu (Jul 15–16) to walk security and procurement through data handling and contract flow.

I'm attaching the materials referenced above. If helpful I can also draft a short Slack note you can drop into Oliver's channel.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: redwood-stakeholder-playbook.pdf (12 KB)] [Attachment: acme-single-slide-roi.pdf (9 KB)] [Attachment: champion-email-template.txt (1 KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder playbook + champion kit for Acme Health evaluation

Hi Stephanie — great call, thanks for the clear recap. A few quick notes: 

- Confirmed contacts: Oliver Grant is the economic buyer (oliver.grant@acmehealth.com). I'll intro him if you prefer, otherwise I can forward your one-pager.
- Security lead: Nadia Shah (n.shah@acmehealth.com) will own SOC2 & architecture review. I'll add her to the thread once I ping her to prioritize.
- Procurement: procure@acmehealth.com is correct; they typically want a pilot SOW + PO and will review any exceptions on indemnity/data terms.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you provide a single-slide ROI that calls out assumptions (tokens/day, model variant, expected latency improvements)?
2) A short <150-word blurb I can use in an exec email to Oliver.

If you can get those by Monday EOD I can loop Oliver and Nadia for a Wed/Thu meeting.

Thanks — Laura
Director, Product Ops | Acme Health
laura@acmehealth.com

Hi Laura — attaching the two items you asked for and a small champion enablement kit:

What I attached
- acme-single-slide-roi.pdf — slide calls out baseline assumptions (50k tokens/day pilot), expected 40% reduction in manual triage time, and projected annualized savings.
- champion-email-template.txt — a 3-line blurb + 1-paragraph exec note you can forward to Oliver.
- redwood-stakeholder-playbook.pdf — expanded playbook with suggested timelines, meeting agenda for security, and procurement checklist.

Champion talk tracks (short lines you can use)
- "This pilot reduces manual triage time by ~40%, freeing clinicians for higher-value tasks — projected $420k run-rate savings for a 6-month rollout."
- "Redwood supports SOC2 evidence and can operate over a private VPC deployment if needed for PHI workflows."
- "We can run an 8-week pilot with a defined rollback and SLA-backed performance for production grading."

Draft intro email (you can forward as-is)
> Oliver — following our discussion on workflow efficiencies, I wanted to introduce Redwood Inference. They can run an 8-week pilot covering three clinical note workflows with predictable latency and a single-slide ROI we've attached. If you agree, can we schedule 30 minutes Tuesday or Wednesday to go over economics?

Next steps
- Laura: forward the one-pager to Oliver and Nadia if you prefer (or request we intro).
- Redwood: Marcus/Monica and I will join the security kickoff and bring SOC2 packet + architecture diagram.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-stakeholder-playbook

Marcus / Monica — quick internal note after Laura confirmed contacts. Proposed internal owners: 
- Marcus: lead procurement/terms conversation and be the point on pricing/discount requests.
- Monica: lead security kickoff and own SOC2 evidence/delivery.

Asks for you both before Wed meeting: 
- Marcus: prepare a pilot SOW template + pricing ranges (we should plan to protect margin but be prepared to offer a pilot discount cap of 20% on list for a committed 12-month conversion).
- Monica: collate SOC2 artifacts, architecture diagram, and a short data flow one-pager (PHI considerations).

I'll draft the intro email for Laura to forward to Oliver/Nadia unless you prefer we send the intro from Redwood. Also hold the Jul 15 slot (30 min) on calendars as tentative.

Thanks — Steph
[Internal note: keep negotiation playbook tight — ask for conversion triggers in SOW: performance, accuracy, and uptime SLAs.]
